1. 1. This matter is taken up through Hybrid Arrangement (Virtual /Physical Mode).
2. Heard learned counsel for the Petitioner as well as learned Additional Standing Counsel for the State.
Perused the records.

3. This is an application under Section 482 BNSS, 2023 filed by the Petitioner for anticipatory bail,
involving offence punishable under Sections 420/34 of the Indian Penal Code read with Section 66(C) & 66(D) of Information Technology Act, 2000.
4. It is stated by the learned counsel for the Petitioner that in the alleged offences no money has been exchanged.
He further contended that the Petitioner has been falsely implicated in the present case.
Further he submitted that the Petitioner does not have any criminal antecedent.

6. Considering the submissions of the learned counsel for the Petitioner, the Petitioner is directed to surrender and move for bail before the learned J.M.F.C., Jharigam in G.R.Case No.134 of 2024 arising out of Jharigaon P.S.Case No.137 of 2014 within a period of three weeks from today.

In such eventuality, learned court in seisin over the matter shall do well to release the Petitioner on bail on such terms and conditions as the learned Magistrate may deem just and proper in the facts and circumstances of the case, but subject to verification of criminal antecedent.
